What This Actually Is and Why It Matters

Automated ebook delivery after crypto payment refers to the seamless process of delivering digital products, in this case ebooks, to customers upon successful crypto payment processing. This process eliminates the need for manual intervention, reducing the risk of human error and increasing the overall efficiency of your sales operations. By integrating crypto payment processing with automated ebook delivery, you're able to provide a better experience for your customers, while also saving time and resources. This is about more than just technical capabilities; it's about creating a seamless and secure shopping experience that builds trust with your customers and sets your business up for long-term success.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture behind automated ebook delivery after crypto payment involves a combination of technologies, including Cloudflare Pages, Cloudflare Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments. When a customer makes a payment using crypto, NOWPayments verifies the transaction and triggers a webhook that notifies your Cloudflare Workers to initiate the ebook delivery process. Your Cloudflare Workers then use Supabase to retrieve the customer's details and deliver the ebook via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. This entire process happens in real-time, ensuring a seamless experience for your customers. The beauty of this architecture lies in its scalability, flexibility, and customizability, making it an ideal solution for businesses of all sizes.
